lines.zh: 我贴着海草床飞快穿梭。
lines.en: I dart quickly through the seagrass bed.

lines.zh: 针一样的长嘴先我一步开路。
lines.en: My needle snout goes first and clears the way.

lines.zh: 我们一群鱼拐弯从不同时。
lines.en: My school turns together, never one at a time.

lines.zh: 温水浅海的沙底是我的跑道。
lines.en: The sandy shallows are my running track.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆我就窜出两格远。
lines.en: One tail flick shoots me two blocks ahead.

lines.zh: 我沿着暖流边缘绕圈巡游。
lines.en: I circle along the edge of the warm current.

lines.zh: 小身板转弯几乎不用减速。
lines.en: My small body turns without slowing down.

lines.zh: 海草擦过我的侧鳍痒痒的。
lines.en: Seagrass brushes my side fins and tickles.

lines.zh: 我跟在前一条鱼的正后方。
lines.en: I swim right behind the fish ahead.

lines.zh: 水面亮起来我就往浅处走。
lines.en: When the surface brightens I head shallower.

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙上细得像线。
lines.en: My shadow on the sand is thin as thread.

lines.zh: 逆流时我把身体压得更低。
lines.en: Against the current I press my body lower.

lines.zh: 一群针鱼游过像撒了银针。
lines.en: A school of us passes like scattered silver needles.

lines.zh: 我绕开礁石，从缝里钻过去。
lines.en: I slip around the reef through a narrow gap.

lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚边缘绕了个弯。
lines.en: I curve around the coral's edge.

lines.zh: 浪从侧面推我，我偏一点。
lines.en: A wave shoves me from the side; I angle off.

lines.zh: 沙面上我的影子一晃就没了。
lines.en: My shadow flickers on the sand, then is gone.

lines.zh: 前面那条大鱼，我往上闪开。
lines.en: A big fish ahead. I dart upward.

lines.zh: 暖水从左边来，我顺着走。
lines.en: Warm water comes from the left, so I follow it.

lines.zh: 我游进鱼群中间，谁也没撞。
lines.en: I cut into the school without touching a fin.

lines.zh: 我悬在水草间慢慢摆尾。
lines.en: I hover among the weeds and sway slowly.

lines.zh: 有东西漂过我先把嘴张开。
lines.en: When something drifts by I open my mouth first.

lines.zh: 我在数头顶有几条大鱼。
lines.en: I count the big fish passing overhead.

lines.zh: 刚才那口碎食还卡在牙边。
lines.en: A crumb of food still sticks by my teeth.

lines.zh: 我小小的鳃一直扇个不停。
lines.en: My tiny gills keep flapping without rest.

lines.zh: 这片海草床今天格外安静。
lines.en: This seagrass bed is unusually quiet today.

lines.zh: 我把嘴对准水流等食物。
lines.en: I point my mouth into the current and wait.

lines.zh: 一条头足类躲进了石缝。
lines.en: A cephalopod has hidden in a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我听见远处鲨鱼翻身的水声。
lines.en: I hear a shark roll over far away.

lines.zh: 我身上只有六点生命值。
lines.en: Six points of health is all I carry.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖背鳍上的细沙。
lines.en: I shake the fine sand off my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 水流推我一下我懒得抵抗。
lines.en: The current nudges me and I do not resist.

lines.zh: 我在等鱼群重新聚拢。
lines.en: I wait for the school to gather again.

lines.zh: 嘴里空着让我有点不安。
lines.en: An empty mouth makes me a little restless.

lines.zh: 这个两条腿的东西比我大太多了。
lines.en: This two-legged thing is far bigger than me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你的脸，像看一座墙。
lines.en: I look up at your face like a wall.

lines.zh: 你是抓我的还是喂我的？
lines.en: Are you here to catch me or feed me?

lines.zh: 你指间那点光，我盯着。
lines.en: I stare at the glint between your fingers.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的水面。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the water above me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢后退，但没游远。
lines.en: I back away slowly but do not flee far.

lines.zh: 我从你靴边探头看了一下。
lines.en: I peek out from beside your boots.

lines.zh: 你弯腰时我吓得沉了半格。
lines.en: When you bend down I sink half a block.

lines.zh: 我在判断你会不会伸手。
lines.en: I am judging whether you will reach in.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也僵在水里。
lines.en: You hold still, so I freeze in the water.

lines.zh: 疼，我一下窜出好远。
lines.en: That hurt, and I bolt far away.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片掉了一小片。
lines.en: A small scale has come off me.

lines.zh: 我拼命摆尾才没被抓住。
lines.en: I flap my tail hard to escape the grab.

lines.zh: 这比我预想的重多了。
lines.en: That landed harder than I expected.

lines.zh: 我缩进海草里抖了一下。
lines.en: I shrink into the seagrass and tremble.

lines.zh: 伤口在水里刺刺地疼。
lines.en: The wound stings sharply in the water.

lines.zh: 我转身就跑，不顾队形。
lines.en: I turn and flee, forgetting the formation.

lines.zh: 六点生命值经不起几下。
lines.en: Six points of health will not last long.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还咬着半口气。
lines.en: I am still holding half a breath.

lines.zh: 再来一下我就完了。
lines.en: One more hit and I am finished.

lines.zh: 那点碎鱼肉的味道飘过来了。
lines.en: The smell of chopped fish drifts over here.

lines.zh: 你要是丢只小虾我就过去。
lines.en: Drop a small shrimp and I will come.

lines.zh: 我闻到软软的头足类气味。
lines.en: I smell something soft and cephalopod-like.

lines.zh: 食物在水里，我绕了两圈。
lines.en: The food floats there, so I circle twice.

lines.zh: 我贴着你手边打转不肯走。
lines.en: I circle your hand and refuse to leave.

lines.zh: 那一小块比海草好吃多了。
lines.en: That little piece beats seagrass any day.

lines.zh: 我馋得长嘴都开始抖。
lines.en: I am so greedy my long snout trembles.

lines.zh: 你把食物按进水里，我冲了。
lines.en: You dunk the food, and I charge in.

lines.zh: 我抢到一口就掉头跑开。
lines.en: I snatch one bite and dart away.

lines.zh: 别收手，我还没吃够。
lines.en: Do not pull your hand back, I am not done.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你的膝盖上。
lines.en: I bump my head right into your knee.

lines.zh: 针尖似的前嘴顶了你一下。
lines.en: My needle-like snout pokes you once.

lines.zh: 抱歉，鱼群太挤我刹不住。
lines.en: Sorry, the school is crowded and I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 我从你腿缝里挤过去。
lines.en: I squeeze through the gap between your legs.

lines.zh: 你一动，我被水推得打转。
lines.en: You move, and the water spins me around.

lines.zh: 我撞上你手里的桶沿。
lines.en: I knock against the rim of your bucket.

lines.zh: 长嘴撞歪了，我甩甩头。
lines.en: My long snout knocked aside; I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我贴着你游过去，擦了一下。
lines.en: I swim past you and graze your side.

lines.zh: 水花溅起来，我躲都躲不开。
lines.en: The splash rises and I cannot dodge it.

lines.zh: 我被你挡在礁石和你之间。
lines.en: I am trapped between the reef and you.

lines.zh: 你后退一步，我正好撞上。
lines.en: You step back and I hit you exactly.

lines.zh: 我甩甩嘴，当刚才没发生。
lines.en: I shake my snout and pretend nothing happened.

lines.zh: 我要找一条同样细长的伴。
lines.en: I want a partner just as slender as me.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，尾巴一个节奏。
lines.en: We swim side by side, tails in one rhythm.

lines.zh: 海草床深处是我们产卵的地方。
lines.en: Deep in the seagrass bed is where we spawn.

lines.zh: 我用嘴碰碰她的侧鳍。
lines.en: I nudge her side fin with my snout.

lines.zh: 她游开了，我得追上去。
lines.en: She swims off, so I have to follow.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此转了三圈。
lines.en: We circle each other three times over.

lines.zh: 这一群小鱼会有自己的小鱼。
lines.en: This school will soon have small fry of its own.

lines.zh: 我把最平的水草让给她。
lines.en: I give her the calmest patch of seagrass.

lines.zh: 两条针鱼并游像一支箭。
lines.en: Two needlefish swimming together look like one arrow.

lines.zh: 她点头了，我摆尾回应。
lines.en: She dips her head, and I flick my tail back.

lines.zh: 这块食物沉底了，我叼起来。
lines.en: This food sank, so I pick it up.

lines.zh: 我捡水里漂着的碎渣吃。
lines.en: I eat the scraps drifting in the water.

lines.zh: 掉下去的东西归我了。
lines.en: Whatever falls down here belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我用嘴把食物从沙里翻出来。
lines.en: I flip the food out of the sand with my snout.

lines.zh: 这块太大，我只能啄着吃。
lines.en: This piece is too big, so I peck at it.

lines.zh: 我叼着它游到水草后面。
lines.en: I carry it behind the seagrass.

lines.zh: 有别的鱼来抢，我先护住。
lines.en: Another fish comes for it, so I guard first.

lines.zh: 我把食物顶在嘴尖上。
lines.en: I balance the food on my snout tip.

lines.zh: 捡到的每口都算今天的好运。
lines.en: Every scrap I find counts as today's luck.

lines.zh: 吃完我把嘴在沙上擦了擦。
lines.en: After eating I wipe my snout in the sand.

lines.zh: 那只小虾离我不到一格。
lines.en: That shrimp is less than a block away.

lines.zh: 我看见一只头足类在动。
lines.en: I spot a cephalopod moving down there.

lines.zh: 这条小鱼游得慢，我要它。
lines.en: That small fish swims slow, and I want it.

lines.zh: 我锁定了沙底那团软东西。
lines.en: I lock onto that soft lump on the sand.

lines.zh: 它比我小，那就是我的饭。
lines.en: It is smaller than me, so it is my meal.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，嘴对准它。
lines.en: I lower my body and aim my snout.

lines.zh: 目标在礁石边，我绕过去。
lines.en: The target is by the reef, so I go around.

lines.zh: 我听见它拨水的小声音。
lines.en: I hear the tiny sound of it pushing water.

lines.zh: 它停住了，这是好机会。
lines.en: It has stopped, and that is my chance.

lines.zh: 我选最弱的那一只下手。
lines.en: I go for the weakest one of the group.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，不让水花起来。
lines.en: I close in without making a splash.

lines.zh: 我的长嘴指着它的背。
lines.en: My long snout points at its back.

lines.zh: 再近半格我就能咬到。
lines.en: Half a block closer and I can bite.

lines.zh: 它一跑我就换方向。
lines.en: If it runs, I switch direction at once.

lines.zh: 我在等它离开石头边。
lines.en: I wait for it to leave the rock's edge.

lines.zh: 身体绷紧，尾巴几乎不动。
lines.en: My body tightens and my tail barely moves.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的鳃盖起伏。
lines.en: I watch the rise and fall of its gills.

lines.zh: 它没发现我贴着海草。
lines.en: It has not noticed me against the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我数着距离，一格一格。
lines.en: I count the distance, one block at a time.

lines.zh: 细长的身体像一支箭。
lines.en: My long thin body is a living arrow.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在它背上。
lines.en: I bite down on its back.

lines.zh: 长嘴戳进去，只有三点伤害。
lines.en: My snout stabs in for just three damage.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，甩了两下。
lines.en: I hold on and shake it twice.

lines.zh: 它挣开了，血丝散在水里。
lines.en: It breaks free, and red drifts in the water.

lines.zh: 这一下够它受的了。
lines.en: That hit is enough for it.

lines.zh: 我咬完马上退开半格。
lines.en: After biting I retreat half a block.

lines.zh: 我的牙小，但很尖。
lines.en: My teeth are small but very sharp.

lines.zh: 它翻过来了，我不松口。
lines.en: It flips over and I keep my grip.

lines.zh: 我戳它侧面最软的地方。
lines.en: I jab the softest spot on its side.

lines.zh: 打赢了我就原地吃。
lines.en: Once I win, I eat right there.

lines.zh: 我们四条针鱼一起进这片海。
lines.en: Four of us needlefish enter this sea together.

lines.zh: 温水海洋里忽然多了几条细影。
lines.en: A few thin shadows appear in the warm ocean.

lines.zh: 我从海草边缘游进这个世界。
lines.en: I swim into this world from the seagrass edge.

lines.zh: 这次只来了我和另外两条。
lines.en: Only I and two others came this time.

lines.zh: 浅海的沙子先落在我眼里。
lines.en: Shallow-sea sand is the first thing I see.

lines.zh: 我出生时尾巴还没使上劲。
lines.en: My tail could barely move when I was born.

lines.zh: 海草床接纳了我们这一小群。
lines.en: The seagrass bed takes in our little school.

lines.zh: 我一落地就去找吃的。
lines.en: I go looking for food the moment I arrive.

lines.zh: 水温刚好，我决定留下。
lines.en: The water is just right, so I stay.

lines.zh: 我们的队伍从三只开始。
lines.en: Our school starts with three of us.

lines.zh: 水边的火烫得我乱窜。
lines.en: Fire near the water sends me darting.

lines.zh: 摔在沙上，我半天没动。
lines.en: I hit the sand and lie still.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里，可也会呛。
lines.en: I belong in water, yet I still choke.

lines.zh: 这一声响把我震得发懵。
lines.en: The blast leaves my head ringing.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的侧鳍。
lines.en: Something has pierced my side fin.

lines.zh: 一股怪力钻进我的鳃里。
lines.en: Strange force crawls into my gills.

lines.zh: 空着肚子，我游得越来越慢。
lines.en: With an empty belly I swim slower and slower.

lines.zh: 水面一亮，我整个人麻了。
lines.en: The water flashes and my whole body numbs.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，只有空。
lines.en: Below is nothing at all, only emptiness.
